        priority = self.active_alarms[alarm]
        if priority == 1:  # high severity
            self.display.set_color("red")
            self.display.set_flashing(0.5, 0.5)  # 2Hz, 50% duty cycle
        else:  # low severity
            self.display.set_color("yellow")
            self.display.set_constant("yellow")
